claims.content: The VMU User initiates the voucher batch creation process in the Voucher Creation / Preparation module.
The system generates voucher numbers for the batch with unique identification numbers and security protocols in-built.
The system creates each voucher with the project code, group batch code, batch number, voucher number, and security code.
Upon completion of voucher batch creation, the system prints all codes in bar-code form to complement or be stuck on the voucher.
The printed voucher batch has three tear-off portioned slips, including a sub-section tear-off for the partner.
